status: schema only: term definitions, origins and closure rules. It carries no power numbers; instances are produced from a closed architecture operating point. Not wired into abep_sim (wiring is a model change for the owner).

boundary.definition: P_bus = all electrical power crossing the spacecraft-side DC boundary into the propulsion system: discharge + pre-ionizer + cathode + magnets + PPU losses + gas path (compressor, valves/flow control) + controls + thermal control (heaters) + any other propulsion load. Wording follows the CLAUDE.md admissibility rule for bus_power_boundary_v1.
boundary.plane: input terminals of the PPU converters on the regulated spacecraft bus (abep_sim/ppu.py:PPU.V_bus); matches loads['P_bus_W'] of abep_sim/ppu.py:PPU.loads as used by abep_sim/archengine.py:close_architecture
never_P_bus: absorbed RF or microwave power in the source plasma (abep_sim/plasma_devices.py:ECRSource.absorbed, RFSource.absorbed); the bus-side quantity is the DC converter output P_ion_W plus its conversion loss
Hall discharge-only power (I_d x V_d) reported alone
boundary.outside: solar-array generation, EPS/battery round-trip losses and spacecraft housekeeping loads (abep_sim/mission_env.py:array_area_for sizes arrays from P_bus; those losses are not propulsion bus terms)
boundary.alignment: bus_power_boundary_v1 is named in CLAUDE.md but is not present in the tree at base efc4a4e; when it lands, its field names take precedence and this ledger is re-mapped to them (gap G8)

modes.steady: firing steady state; the only mode archengine close_architecture evaluates
modes.startup: cathode heater + keeper x1.5 + compressor spin-up x1.8 (abep_sim/ppu.py:load_modes 'startup'); not evaluated by archengine (gap G7)
modes.peak: maximum simultaneous draw (e.g. solar-max flow, Xe augmentation); no producer in archengine (gap G7)

value_record: as defined in subsystem_ledger_v1.value_record (value, unit, status, origin, evidence; null value unless status is computed)

terms.definition: DC output of the Hall anode supply at its load plane (discharge power I_d x V_d)
terms.superseded_by: discharge_power_W of an admitted transport-ensemble member's design Hall map (hallthruster_bridge/hall_map_schema_v1.json, abep_sim/hall_map.py:HallMap); the credible set is empty, so value is null (TBD)

terms.definition: accelerating-stage supply of non-Hall families screened by archengine (grids anode, MPD, PIT capacitor charger, electrothermal heater)
terms.origin: abep_sim/archengine.py:_propulsion P_acc_W (grids / mpd / pit / thermal branches)
terms.note: screening families only; CLAUDE.md rule 8 (no new propulsion families) applies

terms.definition: DC output of the pre-ionizer supply (RF amplifier or ECR/microwave HV supply) into the source, when the architecture has one
terms.note: the 'jet' share appears only when jet power exceeds the accelerating supply (from_src in close_architecture); absorbed plasma power is not a bus term

terms.definition: cathode/neutralizer supplies: keeper (LaB6), heater (startup), plasma-bridge source (air cathodes)
terms.note: steady total only; heater draw exists only in abep_sim/ppu.py:load_modes 'startup'

terms.origin: abep_sim/archengine.py:close_architecture P_mag (code constant for hall / nozzle / ECR architectures)

terms.definition: valve actuation/holding and flow-controller power on both propellant paths (atmospheric valve, Xe valve/regulator)
terms.origin: TBD — requires valve and flow-controller selection for both propellant paths with holding/actuation power data

terms.definition: the 'aux' converter load that the code carries without naming its consumer
terms.note: counted so the ledger closes; to be re-allocated to P_valves_control and/or P_avionics once the consumer is defined

terms.definition: heater power (gas chamber, Xe tank/lines, electronics survival) set by the cold-case (eclipse) thermal solution
terms.origin: TBD — requires heater set-points and a heater-power derivation from the cold case of abep_sim/thermal.py:size_radiator (computed there, not converted into heater power)
abep_sim/ppu.py:PPU.loads (controller_W + sensors_W, code constants, included in P_bus_W and P_loss_W)

terms.definition: conversion losses of all PPU converters (P_in - P_out summed over converters)
terms.origin: abep_sim/ppu.py:PPU.loads (P_loss_W minus controller_W and sensors_W) with abep_sim/ppu.py:Converter.efficiency

terms.definition: resistive loss in the bus-side and load-side harness
terms.origin: TBD — requires harness lengths, gauges and currents; abep_sim/ppu.py:PPU.mass sizes harness mass only

closure.identity: P_bus_W = sum over terms of P_term_W (each term at the bus side, i.e. load-plane power plus its converter loss booked in P_PPU_losses)
closure.residual: resid = (P_bus_W - sum_terms P_term_W) / P_bus_W, with P_bus_W taken from abep_sim/ppu.py:PPU.loads
closure.gate: |resid| <= 0.02 (abep_sim/archengine.py:close_architecture rejects the candidate as 'energy_ledger' otherwise; CLAUDE.md rule 4)
closure.golden_comparison: near-zero ledger_resid values are compared with an absolute tolerance (CLAUDE.md gate 6)

completeness.rule: closure is reported with a completeness flag, never as complete while a term is TBD

values.CLOSED_ALL_TERMS: |resid| <= 0.02 and every applicable term has status computed
values.CLOSED_MODELED_TERMS_ONLY: |resid| <= 0.02 over computed/partial terms; at least one applicable term is TBD (list them in open_terms)
values.NOT_EVALUABLE: an applicable term is superseded (e.g. P_discharge while the Hall credible set is empty); no P_bus is reported

closure.cap_check: P_bus_W <= abep_sim/constants.py:RFPConstraints power_max_W is checked only on CLOSED_ALL_TERMS instances; on CLOSED_MODELED_TERMS_ONLY it is reported as a lower bound (missing TBD terms can only add power)
closure.per_mode: the identity and gate apply to each mode separately (steady, startup, peak); a mode without a producer is status TBD, not copied from steady

instance_required_fields.operating_point_ref: design variables x_* and gas-path state
instance_required_fields.terms: {term_id: value_record} for every term above (not_applicable with reason where the architecture lacks it)
instance_required_fields.ensemble_member_id: required when P_discharge is computed from an admitted member's design Hall map; null otherwise
